name: Khartag Point
summary: Khartag Point is a delve found in the Bitter Coast region of Vvardenfell, west-southwest of Ald'ruhn, containing Camonna Tong and wildlife. Home to Ropefish leader Khartag and his faction, it has been attacked by the Camonna Tong, a ruthless criminal organization. The following letters can be found here: A One-Time Offer, Blood-Soaked Letter and My Dearest Love. Omaren Trial Transcript can be found in a boat at the entrance to the delve. Dragonflies and shroom beetles are found in numbers within.
notes: Khartag Point also appeared in Morrowind.
